goodsReceipt.title: Goods receipt
goodsReceipt.subtitle: Stores count what arrived and give the lot; quality checks the lot before it is used
goodsReceipt.noCompany: No company yet. Admin adds companies on Admin → Companies.
goodsReceipt.readOnly: Read-only access: receipts can be seen but not posted.
goodsReceipt.noRight: You don't have the right to receive goods. Ask Admin.
goodsReceipt.directNote: Without a purchase order the receipt is a direct purchase and needs Admin approval; the server checks it.
goodsReceipt.directNoRight: Without a purchase order only someone who approves purchases (Admin) can post the receipt.
goodsReceipt.noOrders: No issued order is waiting for goods
goodsReceipt.linkedNote: Linked to purchase order {{no}}. Only its lines can be received, up to what was ordered.
goodsReceipt.chooseOrderNote: Choose the purchase order the goods came against.
goodsReceipt.nothingPending: Everything on this order has been received.

err.place: Choose the store the goods go into.
err.line: Line {{n}}: give the item and a quantity (up to 3 decimals).
err.noLines: Enter at least one received quantity.

whatPosting.title: What posting does
whatPosting.stock: Adds the counted quantity to the store under the lot number.
whatPosting.qc: Items that need an incoming test stay in QC hold until quality passes and releases the lot (never by the person who received it).
whatPosting.bill: The supplier's bill is then matched with the order and this receipt on Bill photo capture.

goodsReceipt.confirmEffect: Adds {{n}} lines from {{supplier}} into {{store}} under their lot numbers. Items needing an incoming test go into QC hold. A posted receipt is never edited.
goodsReceipt.heldNote: {{n}} lots wait for the incoming test.

list.title: Goods receipts
list.emptyBody: Receipts appear here once stores post them against an order.
